_notes: Copy to recognizer-overrides.json to change recognizer settings between
calls without restarting the app — the file is re-read on every call, which
is how tools/sweep-max-delay.sh runs the matrix.
Keys are the camelCase names from lib/recognizer-config.js, not the
Speechmatics wire names. Anything omitted keeps its built-in default.
transcriptFiltering requires jambonz v11+ — older instances reject
rejects transcript_filtering_config, which is why they normalize time
formats client-side after the webhook instead.
